Review this Swift function. Is there a defect? If so, state precisely what it is.

```swift
/// Colloquial synonyms -> relations ("dad", "mom", "kids"...).
static func relation(fromWord word: String) -> Relation? {
    switch word.lowercased() {
    case "father", "dad": return .father
    case "mother", "mom": return .mother
    case "brother": return .brother
    case "sister": return .sister
    case "siblings", "brothers", "sisters": return .siblings
    case "son": return .son
    case "daughter": return .daughter
    case "children", "kids", "sons", "daughters": return .children
    default: return nil
    }
}
```

Context: `relatives(.brother, of:)` filters to sex "M" and returns an array; `relatives(.siblings, of:)` returns every sibling unfiltered.
